The task described the base `BulkRenameView` as *"already implementing this check,"* but it actually only supported a single implicit `field_name`. - **`_rename_objects(...)`** — now computes new values for each selected field, stored on `obj.new_values`. It still sets `obj.new_name` (first field) so the existing preview template keeps rendering.
- **`post(...)`** — validates the form, and when `rename_fields` is defined but no valid `field_names` was submitted, adds a form error (`"At least one field must be selected for renaming."`). The apply step iterates over all selected fields when saving.
- Added `field_names`/`rename_fields` to the render context.
